architecture.family: DeepONet: branch [3,w,w,p], trunk [1,q,p], Hadamard combine, head Linear(p,6)
architecture.activation: tanh between branch layers and after every trunk layer (none on branch output or head) -- ACTIVATION ABLATION

placement.label: Lu-stated / DeepXDE-reference placement; primary source-supported reconstruction

architecture.weight_init_note: implemented with torch.nn.init.xavier_normal_; same Glorot/Xavier fan-in/fan-out variance rule as the DeepXDE reference; PyTorch samples an untruncated normal whereas the old TensorFlow Glorot-normal implementation uses truncated-normal sampling

preprocessing.trunk_input: raw physical t in seconds (repository grid, no scaling)
preprocessing.branch_scaling: TG0/ROH0 by their species' author-global min/max; T0 by the min/max of all initial temperatures

author_global_stats.source: ChemKAN_biodiesel_example.jl: species min/max over ode_data_list (train obs + test obs + noise-free test, all times); T min/max over all initial temperatures

metrics.mean_mse: (pred - obs)^2 mean in the trained representation
metrics.mean_mse_u: (pred - obs)^2 mean in author-global u units (time-averaged Eq. 18)
metrics.eq18_obs: author-global u; mean over species, SUM over time, mean over trajectories
metrics.eq22_true: same reduction against the noise-free truth

noise.formula: clean + randn * p * max_t(clean) per trajectory and species, clipped at 0 (additive_species_max)
